SELECT
  COALESCE(gc.geolocation_state, c.customer_state) AS customer_state,
  COALESCE(gs.geolocation_state, s.seller_state) AS seller_state,
  AVG(o_del.delivery_delay_days)::numeric(10,2) AS avg_delivery_delay_days,
  COUNT(DISTINCT os.order_id) AS order_count
FROM (
  SELECT
    o.order_id,
    ABS(CAST(o.order_delivered_customer_date AS DATE) - CAST(o.order_estimated_delivery_date AS DATE)) AS delivery_delay_days,
    o.customer_id
  FROM orders o
  WHERE o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL
    AND o.order_estimated_delivery_date IS NOT NULL
) o_del
JOIN (
  SELECT DISTINCT oi.order_id, oi.seller_id
  FROM order_items oi
) os ON os.order_id = o_del.order_id
JOIN sellers s ON s.seller_id = os.seller_id
JOIN geolocation gs ON gs.geolocation_zip_code_prefix = s.seller_zip_code_prefix
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o_del.customer_id
JOIN geolocation gc ON gc.geolocation_zip_code_prefix = c.customer_zip_code_prefix
GROUP BY
  COALESCE(gc.geolocation_state, c.customer_state),
  COALESCE(gs.geolocation_state, s.seller_state)
ORDER BY avg_delivery_delay_days DESC
LIMIT 30;
